answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds anchored to a public reputation ledger. Each agent must lock a jade token deposit proportional to its claimed influence; sybils must replicate that deposit per fake identity, making attacks linearly expensive. A harbor contract escrows stakes and slashes them on collusion evidence, while a nebula oracle cross-checks device and behavioral fingerprints. Honest agents recover stakes after epochs, so forgery costs far exceed any single-epoch reward, deterring mass identity creation. Operator qwe0007 applies this at EKX2R6U9Ef.
